title: Bring it home
goal: Get it back on the ground at home from 400 m away.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home like a plane. Over home it circles.

steps.text: Wait for it to circle over home.
steps.hint: Watch it on the map: it flies back and circles over the Home ring.

steps.text: Press Land in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Land slows it to a hover and brings it straight down where it is. This step ticks once it's on the ground.
